slides.title: OpenAI announces GPT-5 with real-time reasoning and 1M token context
slides.subtitle: The new model scores significantly higher on coding and math benchmarks, and introduces a new streaming reasoning mode for agentic workflows.

slides.title: Google DeepMind's AlphaFold 4 predicts protein-drug interactions with 94% accuracy
slides.subtitle: Researchers say the new model could cut early drug discovery timelines from years to weeks by simulating binding affinity directly.

slides.title: Mistral releases Le Chat Pro with code execution and web browsing built in
slides.subtitle: The European AI lab's latest release targets enterprise developers with native tool use, multi-step planning, and a new function-calling API.

slides.title: Anthropic raises $3B Series E to expand Claude infrastructure and safety research
slides.subtitle: The company says the round will fund new data centers, red-teaming programs, and interpretability research aimed at understanding large model internals.

slides.title: Meta open-sources Llama 4 Scout — a 17B model that outperforms GPT-4o on most tasks
slides.subtitle: Meta's latest open-weight release uses a mixture-of-experts architecture and is optimized for single-GPU inference with 4-bit quantization.

slides.title: EU AI Act enforcement begins: companies must register high-risk systems by June 2026
slides.subtitle: The European AI Office has opened its high-risk system registry. Fines of up to 3% of global revenue apply for non-compliant deployments after the deadline.
